statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 14 is in the low band and remains below the block threshold, with the single mapped danger window falling on Aug 28.
recommendation: The session closed directionally higher and the assessment firms modestly. NQ extended to a fresh 29,706.75 high after the cash bell and trades 29,650.00, while the Nasdaq-100 cash index settled 29,641.56, within two points of its own 29,643.53 session high. That is genuine continuation evidence, and it is why the dominant mode moves to trend-up and Tail firms from 12 to 14. It stops short of a mean-reversion failure because the roughly 57-point pullback from the new high held and was only partly recovered, because the advance is extraordinarily narrow at 156 of 503 S&P 500 members higher, and because VIX fell 4.8% to 14.48 rather than confirming a stress-driven trend. Stress holds at 48 on that narrow composition, firm crude and hawkish symposium commentary ahead of the keynote. The mapped policy state is EA_ON. The single mapped danger window is 14:00-15:30 UTC on Aug 28 around the Fed chair's Jackson Hole keynote and the final Michigan sentiment reading, where a staged repricing is the specific structure capable of denying retracement. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain unaffected by this assessment.
headline: NQ extends to a 29,706.75 high and holds 29,650.00 as the cash index closes 29,641.56 within two points of its own high; breadth stays narrow at 156 of 503 S&P advancers and Tail firms to 14
body:
Nasdaq-100 E-mini futures trade at 29,650.00, up 360.50 points or 1.23%, shortly after the U.S. cash close. The session range is 29,401.75-29,706.75 against a 29,499.50 open and a 29,289.50 prior settlement, and an independent quote source shows 29,649.00 with a 29,708.00 high at the same minute, so the level and the extension are both well corroborated. The structural change since the previous assessment is that the 29,678.50 high that had capped the session was exceeded. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed at 29,641.56, up 417.04 points or 1.43%, on a 29,366.42-29,643.53 range, which places the close within two points of the session high. Closing at the high is continuation, and the dominant mode is set to trend-up on that basis.

What keeps this short of a pathological path is the behaviour around the new high and the composition of the advance. The marginal extension to 29,706.75 was followed by a roughly 57-point retracement that held and has only partly been recovered, so pullbacks are still occurring and still being respected. The advance itself is extraordinarily narrow: the Nasdaq Composite closed 26,541.35, up 1.57%, and the S&P 500 7,730.99, up 0.72%, while only 156 of 503 S&P 500 members were higher and 23 of 30 Dow members were lower, with the Dow up just 0.20% at 53,569.44. Nvidia rose about 8.7% after guiding to roughly $108 billion for the current quarter, Salesforce gained about 22.6% and CrowdStrike about 18%. An index advance carried by a handful of names is more reversible than a broad one, which argues against a persistent index-level one-way path even with a strong headline gain.

Cross-assets are consistent rather than aligned into a single amplifier. VIX is 14.48, down 4.80% on the day, near its 14.42 session low and well below the 15.21 prior close, so implied volatility is decaying rather than confirming a stress trend. The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.68% and the 2-year 4.24%, up 2.4 and 1.8 basis points, which is a firm but unremarkable move. WTI crude is $83.54, up 1.59%, and Brent $89.58, up 1.98%, adding to the inflation backdrop without producing an equity-transmission shock. Fed commentary from the symposium has been hawkish, with Kansas City Fed President Schmid describing rates as very accommodating and inflation as too elevated. None of these amplifiers is aligned with the others in the way that would justify a step into the block band.

The forward risk is concentrated in one window. The Fed chair's first Jackson Hole keynote is scheduled for 14:00 UTC on Aug 28, alongside the final August Michigan sentiment reading, with Chicago PMI 15 minutes earlier. A keynote is structurally multi-stage, with a prepared text, delivery and a subsequent bond-market reaction, and a delayed second leg is the mechanism most capable of denying mean reversion. Conditional Tail therefore steps to 22 and 21 across 14:00-15:30 UTC and then falls back on the assumption of orderly two-way price discovery. Ahead of that, the overnight run holds a 9-12 conditional floor through the CME maintenance break, the Asian session and the European morning. The shared Finviz cross-asset context was collected at 13:07 UTC and is outside the freshness window, so it was not used as evidence; every figure above comes from independent current sources.

lookbackSummary: The window runs from 20:00 UTC on Aug 26 to 19:00 UTC on Aug 27 and covers the Nvidia release hour and its full digestion into a technology-led advance. It opens on the only non-green hour in the window, WATCH with Tail 21 and Stress 66 at the 20:00 UTC release. Futures reopened on the beat and raised guidance, and as the repricing proved orderly the assessment stepped down through 18 and 16 overnight to a 10-11 plateau that held across the Asian and European sessions, with Stress easing from 66 to 45. The U.S. session added only modest firmness: Tail 14 at the 13:00 UTC pre-open hour, then 12, 12 and 11 through the afternoon, a brief trend-up read at 14 in the 17:00 UTC hour as the index pressed higher, and 12 into the closing hour. Three hours are unavailable, at 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27, where no assessment was published. Across the whole window the action mapping stayed at EA_ON apart from the single WATCH hour, and no hour produced the persistent no-retracement structure that Tail measures.
outlookSummary: The horizon runs from 20:00 UTC today to 19:00 UTC on Aug 28 and contains one directional close, an empty overnight and a single genuine catalyst cluster. The current hour carries the observed structure at Tail 14 with the cash close near the session high. The 21:00 UTC CME maintenance break is the structural low of the horizon at 9, and a 10-11 conditional floor then holds across the Globex reopen, the Tokyo and Hong Kong opens and the Asian afternoon. Conditional scores lift gradually from the 06:00 UTC European run-in through the 07:00 UTC cash open to 12-13 as liquidity and pre-event positioning build, with month-end on Aug 31 adding mechanical flow on the final Friday. The cluster is at 13:00-15:00 UTC: Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC just after the U.S. open, then the Fed chair's Jackson Hole keynote and the final Michigan sentiment reading together at 14:00 UTC. Conditional Tail peaks at 22 and 21 across the mapped 14:00-15:30 UTC danger window, the only slots mapped to WATCH, before easing to 17 and then back to 12-13 on the assumption that price discovery is orderly and retracements function. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks in that window would be the invalidation.
